snippet.title: How To God - Creature Feature Trailer | Meta Quest 2/3/3S
snippet.description:
Your physical manifestation in How to God now comes in three different creature forms! 🔴🟣🔵

Choose from an elegant reptile, a wise horned owl, and a fearsome goat creature - all available for you at the start of How to God.

PRE-ORDER NOW (LINK IN BIO)

How to God is an immersive VR god simulation game allowing you to step into the divine sandals of a beginner god. Grow civilizations, raise a unique creature, battle rival deities and command the elements to unlock new powers. 

Will you be a wise and benevolent leader, or a vengeful deity? 
Only you can choose How To God.
